name: spec-to-pr
description: Turn a brief, feature, Figma design, or bounded legacy migration into a Korean draft pull request with truthful visual evidence and Gaps.

interface.shortDescription: Four delivery cases with visual evidence and Gaps.
interface.longDescription: SpecToPR prepares Korean Draft PRs for brief, feature, Figma, and bounded legacy delivery. UI work records truthful visual comparison evidence. Legacy migrations preserve the legacy DOM, CSS, assets, controls, and route/state matrix rather than redesigning with a design system. API and authentication uncertainty becomes a visible Gap, not a false pass or a safe-work blocker.
defaultPrompt: Use the spec-to-pr skill and choose exactly one case: brief, feature, figma, or legacy.
Use the design system for brief, feature, and Figma UI. For legacy, preserve the running legacy DOM/CSS/assets/controls and only convert the framework entry unless redesign is explicitly approved.

For a legacy migration, use Computer Use first when the host exposes it to capture the authenticated running app. Browser/Playwright is only a provider/auth-state/reason-disclosed Gap fallback. Inventory every user-visible legacy route and state, capture baseline/actual/Diff evidence for each or record an explicit reviewer-visible exclusion. Create a Korean Draft PR using the case-specific template; APIs, authentication, binding, and capture failures remain visible as Gaps rather than passed checks. Feature delivery still runs targeted E2E and commits one user-flow video.
